title: What review found: three security fixes in one day.
description: On 21 November review found three security problems across eng, agent-idea and shipper. Each was fixed with a test the same day. Here is what and how.
lede: On 21 November review found a token sent too widely, log lines that slipped past the sanitiser, and a deploy tag that moved too easily. All three were fixed and tested that day.
summary: Three fixes from one day of review: an over-scoped token in eng ops, leaks past the agent-idea sanitiser, and shipper's v1 deploy tag. What changed and how it was tested.
